text:
Rina M.: Idea: run a 4-email 'Convert Blitz' for active trial users who haven't created a model endpoint. Timing = 14 days from signup. Aim: get them to deploy or book a quick setup call.

Ethan T.: good. how narrow is the segment? active trial = ran >=1 completion or embedding call?

Rina M.: active = any API call in last 7 days but no endpoint resource created. exclude anyone marked `converted=true`.

Priya S.: copy angle suggestions: 
- Email 1 (day 0): quick checklist + 1-click deploy CTA
- Email 2 (day 2): short customer mini-case (infra cost saved) + deploy CTA
- Email 3 (day 5): tips & common errors (debug checklist) + scheduler CTA
- Email 4 (day 9): last chance + small promo (1 month free Dedicated trial)

Ethan T.: subject line A/Bs?

Priya S.: put two variants:
A: "Launch an endpoint in 5 minutes"
B: "Need a hand getting your model into prod?"

Jonas K.: Personalization tokens: first_name, product_interest, last_api_call_type. Use product_interest to tweak hero line: inference runtime vs embeddings. Keep body mostly same.

Rina M.: test plan: we want to measure conversion to endpoint. Use 80/20 holdout for variant? maybe 50/50 to detect subject lift.

Ethan T.: prefer 50/50 for statistical speed. sample sizes: we have ~2200 eligible. that's ~1100 per variant, should detect decent lift.

Nate (deliverability-bot): Quick deliverability notes: maintain 3-day rolling suppression for bounce/complaint, throttle to 4000 sends/hr, include List-Unsubscribe header and visible footer. We'll run seed test.

Priya S.: creative asks: small hero screenshot per interest, code snippet block for the quick deploy (use inline code).

Rina M.: snippet example for email 1:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/endpoints -d '{"model":"open-ggml-13b","config":{}}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY'
```
Keep this as single-line code for readability.

Ethan T.: analytics: event to fire `email_convert_blitz_sent` and `email_convert_blitz_clicked`. conversion fires `endpoint_created` property change. Map to campaign dashboard.

Jonas K.: routing: if user books via scheduler or creates endpoint mid-cadence, suppress remaining sends immediately. Also if they click through to docs and convert within 24h, mark as converted and suppress.

Nate (deliverability-bot): preflight checklist run 24h pre-launch: spam-score, seed inbox tests, domain warmup check, DKIM/SPF/DMARC pass. I'll post results in thread.

Priya S.: offer creative alternative for Email 4 copy w/o promo in case legal blocks Dedicated trial: "Schedule a 1:1 optimization call". keep both creative variants ready.

Rina M.: UTM schema: utm_source=blitz14, utm_medium=email, utm_campaign=trial_convert_blitz_2759, utm_content={variant}_{segment}. Ethan, can you add to campaign config?

Ethan T.: added to draft config. Also adding `suppress_on=converted` and `throttle=4000/hr`.

Jonas K.: small experiment: for 10% of the audience, swap subject to curiosity-driven: "What others missed in their first endpoint" — run as exploratory. Keep it separate from main A/B.

Rina M.: ok allocate 10% holdback. track separately.

Ethan T.: timing windows: send between 10-11am recipient local time. rolling send over 72 hours to avoid provider rate spikes.

Nate (deliverability-bot): seeds: will run 20 inbox seeds across providers + Gmail inbox placement check 6h after initial send. Expect report in thread.

Priya S.: final asset checklist needed: 4 subject pairs, 4 bodies with personalization tokens, hero images per product_interest, code snippet, alt text, unsubscribe footer. I'll upload to the shared drive by 3pm.

Rina M.: target launch next Wed. I'll publish segments and schedule the preflight 24h before. Thanks — this should help move more trial users to endpoints.

Jonas K.: ping when assets are up, will queue for review.

Ethan T.: queued config saved as `trial-convert-blitz-2759` (draft). Will run lint and send preview microbatch once creative uploaded.

Nate (deliverability-bot): draft saved. Reminder: if open rate < 12% in seeds, we pause and iterate.

Rina M.: noted. Thanks everyone.
